view.lede: The Park, left-handed: one of the five generic courses that every course without its own build races on for now (galloping). A big, flat, galloping left- or right-handed oval with a long run-in and a straight mile, the teardrop shape the owner settled on for the kit Park (16 Nov: 'a little more teardrop / angular ... 2 chutes'). Dressed as a victorian parkland.
notes: Newcastle, Redcar, Yarmouth, Salisbury, Chepstow, Ayr, Ffos Las, Nottingham, Leicester, Wetherby, Bath.
About 14.2f round, a 4.41f run-in. Drawn from a few numbers (the corners and bends of the loop, the chutes), so it can be reshaped quickly.
Victorian parkland: medium and smaller pieces from the grandstand crib sheet on one front line, the crowd up to the rail; the festival in the infield opposite and up the stand side.
Choose Medium or Low under Quality in the race view's bar. Auto steps down by itself.
